meta.name: The Raikar Case 1080p
meta.description: An edge-of-the-seat thriller about family, love, deceit, and the secrets that wrench us apart. It grapples with the dilemma of 'Will You Choose Truth Over Family?', and if trust can ever really be absolute.

videos.title: Suicide... or a murder?
videos.overview: A seemingly put-together affluent family comes under police scrutiny when its youngest member commits suicide. The Naik Raikars put up a brave front until a message from beyond the grave threatens to break the family apart.

videos.title: Hunt for the killer
videos.overview: As the investigation turns murky, the cracks in the Naik Raikar family begin to surface. Adding insult to injury, a prominent family member is accused of Tarun's murder. Who amongst them is the killer?

videos.title: The evidence doesn't lie
videos.overview: Etasha's 'perfect' family is crumbling before her eyes, revealing how dysfunctional it is at its core. As new evidence comes to light, SP John Pereira asks Etasha to do the unthinkable.

videos.title: Hidden secrets, buried truth
videos.overview: At Tarun's funeral, secrets that were buried deep are unearthed. With each family member now revealing where their allegiance lie, Etasha is left devastated and completely alone. Until she finds an unlikely ally, but can he be trusted?

videos.title: Raikars vs. Raikars
videos.overview: All bets are off as Etasha's search for the truth leads her down a dangerous path. Desperate to know who killed her brother, Etasha won't budge… even if that means taking her own family head-on.

videos.title: Truth over family?
videos.overview: How long can Etasha run away from the truth that has been staring her right in the face? Beaten but not broken, Etasha is about to take a drastic step that might destroy the Naik Raikars forever.

videos.title: Whodunnit?
videos.overview: The betrayal, the deceit, and the secrets - all these have left the Naik Raikars completely exposed! With the entire family under the spotlight, will Tarun's killer finally be caught?
